chunks: Zayd ibn ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn ibn Zayd informed me, saying:

I fell ill, and a physician came to me at night. He prescribed for me a medicine to take at night for so-and-so many days, but I was unable to obtain it. The physician had not yet gone out from the door when Naṣr came to me with a bottle containing that very medicine itself. He said to me: Abū al-Ḥasan sends you greetings of peace and says to you: Take this medicine for so-and-so many days. So I took it and drank it, and I recovered.
Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī said: Zayd ibn ʿAlī said to me, “The fault-finder refuses; where are the ghulāt from this hadith?”

key_terms.أَبُو الْحَسَنِ: the Imam who sent greetings and the medicine
key_terms.السَّلَامَ: the greeting of peace conveyed from the Imam
key_terms.الطَّبِيبُ: the physician who examined him and prescribed the treatment
key_terms.الْغُلَاةُ: the extremists mentioned in the concluding statement
key_terms.دَوَاءً: the medicine prescribed and later sent
key_terms.فَبَرَأْتُ: I recovered; indicating cure after taking the medicine
key_terms.قَارُورَةٍ: a bottle containing the prescribed medicine
key_terms.نَصْرٌ: the person who arrived carrying the bottle of medicine

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe a healing incident connected to Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates an illness of Zayd ibn ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn ibn Zayd and his recovery through a medicine sent by Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام with precise knowledge of the physician’s prescription. It presents an account associated with the Imam’s extraordinary awareness and intervention. The closing remark notes that objectors would resist accepting such a report.

en.sarwar: 9. Certain persons of our people have narrated from Muhammad ibn Ali who has said the following. “Zayd ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Zayd narrated to me as follows. “

I became ill and a doctor came to see me at night. He prescribed a medicine for me to be taken at night for so and so many days. I could not find the medicine that night. The physician was still there that Nasr came in with a bottle that contained the medicine that the physician had prescribed for me and said, “Abu al-Hassan (a.s.) sends you the greeting of peace and has asked you to take this medicine for so and so many days.” I took the medicine and recovered from my illness.”
Muhammad ibn Ali has said that Zayd ibn ail told me, “The critics would refuse to accept this hadith saying, “Wherefrom the extremist have brought this hadith?”
